name: Docket Wire
tagline: Where East Africa's deals stand, and who still has to say yes
description: An independent record of the deals and disputes that reach East Africa's regulators, tribunals and courts: every approval, challenge and date on the record, each with its source, and long-form analysis of what they mean.
lede: Every acquisition, listing and infrastructure concession in the region has to pass a sequence of regulators, tribunals and courts before it can close. Docket Wire keeps a live file on each one, showing which of those gates have said yes, which are still deciding, and what comes next, with every step linked to its source.
